IL1B / CLDN4 one-hop statistic: +0.0279

Lattice adjacency only; spots contain mixtures
Patient-level description, not a spot significance test

The aggregate RNA pattern has detection and spatial components.
Depth, candidate selection and broad composition remain consequential.

Transferred-label selection and epithelial mixtures
RNA depth and background RNA
Tissue geometry and other inflammatory inputs
Sensitivity checks do not identify a unique cause.

Does recipient configuration alter an IL-1 response?
Needs independently established state identity
and protein / functional response measurements.
RNA co-detection is not receptor assembly or signaling.
